requirements.finding: 88 inherited hashes, three exact strong-GRU/current-measurement replays and six official baseline evaluations are recorded; V3 detector, causal IR, ReID, output policy and TrackEval are frozen.
Candidate coverage, stage coverage, reranking, history contamination, lifecycle and unknown/unverified support are separated; the joint intervention is retrospective diagnosis, not an online oracle.

Observable risk, ordinary MLP, threshold, quota and memory-protection controls were compared against ordinary GRU; learned absolute gates do not transfer reliably and deployment recommendation remains the ordinary baseline.

Candidate attention, EMA/no-EMA, masking, corruption, NULL, recoverability evidence, ordinary Transformer and residual relation controls were trained/evaluated with actual accepted histories and exact resume checks; EMA and candidate-JEPA necessity are not independently established.
K=1/K=2, branch isolation, protected writes, nested assignment and full six-video controls are complete; K2 is marginal and lowers the selected AB result, so it is not retained.
Failures were converted into new hypotheses and controls; the conclusion is based on accumulated evidence rather than a fixed number of failed trials.

Three identity-coordinate seeds, per-video/multi-metric official evaluations and a 4,834-frame strict-online risk deployment are recorded. The unretained identity-coordinate candidate was not deployed raw; that limitation is explicit and does not masquerade as a result.

The strong ordinary GRU/current-measurement baseline remains recommended; A/B/C and the candidate identity-coordinate family remain diagnostics, with all important negative results and generalization limits retained.
The prior delivery was independently verified at 0426087; this audit and its state update will be pushed as the final small-file delivery.
